title: 第7章 一阶魔法塔第8章 刷怪练级
content_zh:
第7章 一阶魔法塔
1周第3日。
林天第一时间建造了人族市场－1000金，剩余60900金。
人族市场看起来，就是由很多的五颜六色的帐篷，大批敞棚马车及固定摊位组成，显然用的是英雄无敌3的模板。它已经取消了资源与金币兑换的功能，甚至没有了以前特殊宝物买卖的功能，但某宅并不感到失望，因为市场还保留着他最需要的装备买卖。
，+1防御的铠甲，+1法力的手套和+1知识的头盔。但也仅限与此。以前游戏里每周更新一次的特殊宝物，一件也没有，这些特殊宝物，显然是象幸运四叶草一样，需要通过任务或者杀怪物boss才会出现。
+1攻击武器，+1防御铠甲，+1法力手套，+1知识头盔，价格都一样，100金一件。现在可以卖2000金一件，一本万利啊！在这些图标下方，醒目的有同样4个与之对应的图标，但都是锁定状态。林天估计八成是+2装备的，移上去居然有提示说，10级解锁。
另外一页是卖药品的小红和小蓝，也可以无限购买，10金一瓶，商会那边可以卖200金一瓶，量大起来利润也是不错。但一定要严格控制流入市场的量，无节制的乱来，绝对会破坏市场供求关系，所以现在严格按协议来。
先购买每周的份额小红蓝200瓶，10件+1装备，花费3000金，剩余57900金。
同样，在下方也有被锁定的图标，提示是10级解锁！估摸着是中瓶红蓝药剂。但这种被锁定的图标还有很多，林天猜测系统所提供的药剂，可能并不只限于补充生命和魔力的红蓝药剂，某宅开始YY无敌药剂了……将200瓶小红小蓝，10件+1装备的物品买出来以后，简单的打包放进府库。
从系统选单中，找到绑定回城点的功能，直接绑定在仙林城城主府的金库中……这是系统融合后新增的一个功能，可以指定一座城镇绑定，在外面随时可以获取城镇重要信息，也可以随时传送回来，cd是1天。嘿嘿！加强版的炉石嘛！系统还是很人性化的嘛！某宅决定召唤了1个农民，以后就丢在这里，充当联络员。
找来老管家约翰，这段时间的接触，让林天对老人的忠诚度和办事能力非常放心，毕竟服务了整个家族大半辈子了，完全是值得信赖的。吩咐他以后每周1提醒自己取货，同时每周1找琼斯收取金币，然后放入府库。
“以后与商会的接洽事务，都由你跟进！”顿了顿继续说：“老管家你为家族服务了一辈子，我是完全相信你的。”
老约翰一听，急了；“主人，我还没那么老，还可以为家族服务十年，请务必相信我！”
林天一摆手：“管家你误会了，我绝对信任你！以后家族所有的事务，除非关系到家族存亡的大事，我给你自主决断的权限，请不要辜负我的信任！”约翰顿时老泪纵横。
“老伯你是看着我长大的，我已经不是1级的魔法学徒了，现在我是2级魔法新手，必须出去外面历练提升自己的实力。一个家族是否兴盛，没有家主自身强大的实力怎么行？”
“最近我决定进入魔兽森林历练，放心，我只会在最外围，不会轻易进入深处。在我离开的这段时间，要辛苦你扛起家族的重担。”
一指旁边的农民：“我留下了一个联络员，他有秘法可以把消息通知我，但消耗太大，所以，只有当大事发生时，你才可以把消息传递给他。我可以随时回来！”
安抚好老管家之后。林天需要为魔兽森林历练做准备，学点魔法防身也是非常必要的.
“建造精灵族魔法行会－2000！”剩余55900金。
魔法行会用的是英雄无敌3的模板，圆圆的塔顶闪烁着神秘的魔法光芒，目前只有1层，外面开有很多小窗户，白色的墙壁上还刻画有很多魔纹，给人一种神秘的感觉。

林天刚靠近魔法塔，塔门自动
这层靠墙放置了很多书架，上面堆满了各种书籍。但最重要的是，四周靠墙的地方，空中悬浮着很多颜色各异的魔法卷轴。有红色的，蓝色的，黄色的，青色的以及白色的。分别对应着四系魔法：火，水，地，气，还有最后一种白色的是无属性魔法。
林天好奇的想用手去触碰一张，离地一人高的蓝色卷轴，但被一股柔和的魔力所阻隔。
试着凝神，用精神力去触碰它，感觉到了，是疗伤术。
疗伤术：1阶水系魔法，可以治疗自己和部下，恢复一定量的生命。有机会祛除目标身上的1个有害效果！
确认学习它！
提示：英雄不具备水系能力，无法修习！
再试了试黄色的1阶地系魔法：迟缓大法。
迟缓大法：1阶地系魔法，是受术的敌人，减少一定的移动速度，减少程度与英雄地系魔法等级有关。
提示：英雄不具备地系能力，无法修习！
看来系统还是一如即往的铁面啊。暂时只能学无属性的魔法了，选择白色的1阶无属性魔法神箭。
提示：需要先花费500金购买魔法书，是否购买？
这个跟游戏里一样，当然购买了，花费500金，剩余55400金。
再次用精神力触碰魔法神箭，确认学习。一股华丽的魔法符文流入魔法书。脑海里自然就记忆了这个魔法，释放时只要翻到魔法书的这一页，一手接触默念咒语就能释放，非常方便。
只要买魔法书和造魔法行会需要钱，魔法只要符合学习条件，就是完全免费的，那林天也就不客气了。
大步踏出魔法塔，一种自己也很强力的感觉油然而生。
某宅满怀斗志的召唤出新手战马，踏上了前往魔兽森林外围的征途。
年轻人是该出去搏一搏了！
content_en:
Chapter 7 First-order Magic Tower
3rd day of week 1.
Lin Tian immediately built a human market - 1,000 gold, leaving 60,900 gold.
The human market looks like it is composed of many colorful tents, a large number of open carriages and fixed stalls. It is obviously based on the template of Invincible Heroes 3. It has canceled the function of exchanging resources and gold coins, and even no longer has the function of buying and selling special treasures before. However, a certain house is not disappointed because the market still retains the trading of the equipment he needs most.
, armor with +1 defense, gloves with +1 mana, and helm with +1 knowledge. But that's all. In the past, there were no special treasures that were updated once a week in the game. These special treasures were obviously like lucky four-leaf clovers and only appeared after completing quests or killing monster bosses.
+1 attack weapon, +1 defensive armor, +1 mana gloves, +1 knowledge helmet, all have the same price, 100 gold each. Now you can sell it for 2,000 gold each, making huge profits! Below these icons, there are the same 4 corresponding icons that are eye-catching, but they are all locked. Lin Tian estimated that 80% of them were equipped with +2 equipment. When he moved it up, there was a prompt saying that it was unlocked at level 10.
On the other page are Xiaohong and Xiaolan who sell medicines. You can also buy them unlimitedly. A bottle costs 10 gold. The Chamber of Commerce can sell a bottle for 200 gold. The profit is good if the quantity is large. But we must strictly control the amount flowing into the market. Uncontrolled chaos will definitely destroy the supply and demand relationship in the market, so now we strictly follow the agreement.
First buy the weekly quota of 200 bottles of small red and blue, 10 pieces of +1 equipment, costing 3,000 gold, leaving 57,900 gold.
Similarly, there is also a locked icon below, indicating that it is unlocked at level 10! It's probably the middle bottle of red and blue potion. But there are many such locked icons. Lin Tian guessed that the potions provided by the system may not be limited to red and blue potions that replenish life and magic power. A certain house started to sell invincible potions... After buying 200 bottles of small red and small blue, and 10 +1 equipment items, he simply packed them and put them in the treasury.
From the system menu, find the function of binding the return point, and bind it directly to the treasury of the Lord's Mansion of Xianlin City... This is a new function added after the system integration. You can specify a town to bind. You can obtain important information about the town at any time outside, and you can also send it back at any time. The cd is 1 day. hey-hey! An enhanced version of Hearthstone! The system is still very user-friendly! A certain house decided to summon a farmer, and he will leave it here to act as a liaison.
After finding the old butler John, the contact during this period of time made Lin Tian very reassured about the old man's loyalty and ability. After all, he had served the entire family for most of his life and was completely trustworthy. Instruct him to remind himself to pick up the goods every Monday from now on, and at the same time, ask Jones to collect the gold coins every Monday, and then put them into the treasury.
"You will be responsible for following up on all future contacts with the Chamber of Commerce!" After a pause, he continued: "Old butler, you have served the family your whole life. I completely trust you."
When Old John heard this, he became anxious; "Master, I'm not that old yet. I can still serve the family for ten years. Please believe me!"
Lin Tianyi waved his hand: "Butler, you have misunderstood. I absolutely trust you! In all future family affairs, unless it is related to the survival of the family, I will give you the authority to make your own decisions. Please don't betray my trust!" John burst into tears.
"Old man, you have watched me grow up. I am no longer a level 1 magic apprentice. Now I am a level 2 magic novice. I must go out and practice to improve my strength. How can a family prosper without the strong strength of the family leader?"
"Recently, I decided to enter the Warcraft Forest to experience. Don't worry, I will only be on the outermost periphery and will not easily enter the depths. During the time I am away, I have to work hard for you to shoulder the burden of the family."
Point to the sideFarmer: "I left a liaison behind. He has a secret method to inform me of the news, but it consumes too much, so you can only pass the news to him when something big happens. I can come back at any time!"
After appeasing the old housekeeper. Lin Tian needs to prepare for the Warcraft Forest experience, and it is also very necessary to learn some magic for self-defense.
"Build the Elf Magic Guild - 2000!" There is 55,900 gold left.
The Magic Guild uses the template from Heroes of Might and Magic 3. The round top of the tower is shining with mysterious magic light. It currently only has one floor. There are many small windows outside, and there are many magic patterns carved on the white walls, giving people a mysterious feeling.
Lin Tiangang approached the magic tower, and the tower door automatically
There are many bookshelves placed against the wall on this floor, filled with various books. But the most important thing is that there are many magic scrolls of different colors suspended in the air around the walls. There are red, blue, yellow, cyan and white. They correspond to the four series of magic: fire, water, earth, air, and the last white one is non-attribute magic.
Lin Tian curiously wanted to touch a blue scroll that was a person's height above the ground, but was blocked by a soft magic power.
Try to concentrate and touch it with your spiritual power. You can feel it, it is a healing technique.
Healing: Level 1 water magic, which can heal yourself and your subordinates and restore a certain amount of life. There is a chance to remove 1 harmful effect on the target!
Make sure to learn it!
Tip: The hero does not have the water ability and cannot practice it!
I tried the yellow level 1 earth magic again: Slowness.
Slowness: Level 1 earth magic, the enemy is affected by the spell, and its movement speed is reduced by a certain amount. The degree of reduction is related to the hero's earth magic level.
Tip: The hero does not have the earth ability and cannot practice it!
It seems that the system is still as iron-faced as ever. For the time being, I can only learn magic without attributes, so choose the white level 1 magic arrow without attributes.
Tip: You need to spend 500 gold to buy a magic book first. Do you want to buy it?
This is the same as in the game, of course I bought it, it cost 500 gold, and I have 55,400 gold left.
Touch the magic arrow with your mental power again to confirm the learning. A stream of gorgeous magical runes flowed into the magic book. This magic is naturally memorized in my mind. When releasing it, I only need to turn to this page of the magic book, touch it with one hand and recite the spell silently, which is very convenient.
As long as money is needed to buy magic books and create a magic guild, magic is completely free as long as it meets the learning conditions, so Lin Tian is not welcome.
Stepping out of the magic tower in big strides, a feeling of being very powerful arose spontaneously.
A certain house summoned a novice war horse full of fighting spirit and embarked on a journey to the outskirts of the Warcraft Forest.
It’s time for young people to go out and give it a try!
